assumptions: Two FOCs and regulator BUS assumed equipotential for stored-energy arithmetic only; 5.4 mF regulator capacitance nominal.
No load or sink during constant net 1 kW injection; no ESR, ESL, wiring, tolerance, ageing or delay. 40.3 V is a comparison point, not an allowable voltage or guaranteed trip.
30 kg and 15 km/h are unqualified mechanical comparison inputs; rotating inertia and slope excluded.

central_resistor_static.qualification: ON-state electrical arithmetic only, not average, continuous, pulse, or thermal rating

purchase_counts.reason: No qualified replacement or complete comparable vehicle-level quotes; do not count current regulator resistor twice.

decision.central_only: HOLD: braking envelope, resistor identity and thermal ratings, 12V loss and disconnected power path not closed. FOC BOV BREAK does not dissipate energy.
decision.reduced_capacitors: HOLD: actual local RMS spectrum, effective capacitance, harness loop inductance, overshoot and response delay unspecified; nominal energy does not establish minimum capacitance.
decision.schematic_and_bom: unchanged pending closure; not a validated deletion
